specification.problem: Characterize lazy discrete-time quantum walks on the line: moment scaling, spread of the probability distribution (DFT coin vs Hadamard), and occupancy number/rate. The abstract gives no explicit formulas.
specification.reconstruction_scope: Smallest useful construction: a 1D lazy quantum walk with a 3-dimensional coin (move left, stay, move right) and DFT coin, started at the origin, with the position distribution and n-th moment. Out of scope: the occupancy number/rate definitions (not given), the proofs, the comparison with classical and lazy classical walks, and the exact concentration interval.

symbols.meaning: probability of position x at step t

equations.label: Moment scaling
equations.description: Order of the n-th moment of the lazy walk's distribution.
equations.abstract_quote: lazy quantum walks have $O(t^{n})$ order of the n-th moment of the corresponding probability distribution
equations.justification: The abstract states the O(t^n) order; the sum form is the standard moment definition.
assumptions: P_t is the position distribution after t steps

equations.label: Lazy walk step (assumed)
equations.description: One step of a lazy walk with 3-dimensional coin; c=0 means staying.
equations.justification: A common lazy-walk model; the abstract does not give the exact construction, which may differ (e.g. Childs' lazy walk).
assumptions: Stay amplitude via coin state c=0

equations.label: DFT coin
equations.description: 3x3 DFT coin matrix, with basis indices identified with c via a fixed relabeling.
equations.justification: Standard DFT matrix; the abstract only names a DFT coin without dimension.

equations.label: Initial state
equations.description: Walker at origin with a coin state chi.
equations.justification: Initial coin state not given in the abstract.

registers.name: position
registers.size: ceil(log2(2t+1)) qubits for t steps, symbolic

specification.initial_state: Walker at x=0 with coin state |chi> (assumed, e.g. stay).

steps.description: Repeat t times: apply the DFT coin, then the conditional shift.
Compute the position distribution and moments.

specification.measurement: Measure the position register in the computational basis, repeated to estimate P_t(x).
specification.classical_postprocessing: Estimate moments M_n(t) from the histogram; occupancy number/rate cannot be computed since their definitions are not given.
assumptions: Coin and initial state chosen by me
Tiny instance such as t=3 suggested
missing_information: Definitions of occupancy number and occupancy rate
Precise concentration interval for the DFT walk
Details of the classical and lazy classical comparison
